goal: The git-worktree worker writes a per-run log file under logs/worker/ for every run_id it executes.

references: Root cause: commit acb2aa3 collapsed .workflow/task-worker.sh into .workflow/worker.py. The bash worker redirected each per-task subprocess to a log file (run_workflow ... &> "$logfile"); worker.py runs all tasks in-process via orchestrate and streams to one shared sys.stderr, so no per-run file is written. flywheel.workflow.DEFAULT_LOG_DIR is dead (exported, never referenced).
Old naming convention (git show acb2aa3^:.workflow/task-worker.sh, line 289): logs/worker/${task_id}_${hash}_$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S).log -- keep files greppable by task_id and keyed to the run.
run_once returns OrchestratorReport.runs; each RunRecord carries run_id, task_id, status (see src/flywheel/orchestrator.py).
Per-run content can be rendered from the store's persisted events: SqliteStore.list_domain_events(run_id) plus the existing flywheel.workflow._format_event_line helper.
tests/test_worker.py::test_run_once_merges_completed_task is the model for the regression test (real git repo + fake invoke + run_once).
constraints: The fix belongs in the consumer (.workflow/worker.py). Do NOT change orchestrate's single-stream contract or weaken any flywheel.task/flywheel.lifecycle purity test.

Reconcile the dead DEFAULT_LOG_DIR constant: either wire it up as the default log directory or remove it -- do not leave it dangling. Restore the worker's --log-dir override (the bash worker had one), defaulting to logs/worker/.
Multiple attempts/resumes of the same task must produce distinct, non-clobbering files (key on run_id and timestamp, mirroring the old <task>_<hash>_<ts>.log shape).

Add a regression test to tests/test_worker.py that runs a full run_once cycle (model test_run_once_merges_completed_task) and asserts a logs/worker/ file keyed to the executed run_id exists and is non-empty.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file you touch and fix all Pylance errors before reporting verify.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (fix: ...) before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: Do not reintroduce .workflow/task-worker.sh or any bash worker.
Do not reformat or refactor unrelated code in worker.py or workflow.py.
edge_cases: A run that ends in failed/interrupted should still get a log file (parked-for-forensics runs are exactly when the log matters most).
logs/worker/ may not exist yet on a fresh checkout -- create it.
